title: SettingValue
description: One row per (scope, key). Per-field last-writer-wins on the oplog via hlc. See platform plan 3.1, 3.2, and docs/SETTINGS.md in .github.

key.description: Dotted, lowercase, owned by exactly one package (docs/PACKAGES.md naming rule). Must exist in the settings registry.

value.description: Shape depends on the key's selector type in the settings registry; validated against that, not here.

source.description: Where this value last came from, for the settings UI's modified filter.
